brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.

requirements.evidence: North-half bases at level 0 and level 1.
Drawer on the level 0 cut face.
capOpenFaces added 6 caps. lockJoints was also run. check_build reports no issues and meshClash is clear.

finish.summary: I built a two-storey organizer from two north-half bases stacked. The top storey has a 2-compartment bin. The bottom storey has a drawer. All open faces are capped and the joints are locked. I added no props. It has one bin, not several, because a single hex cell holds only one bin.

lines.label: Bin, north half, full depth, 2 compartments
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
